blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — An estimated 7,000 people gathered for the Siomai Festival in Barangay Tisa, Cebu City on Saturday, September 26, as police and partner agencies maintained security and traffic measures throughout the celebration. In a statement, the Cebu City Police Office (CCPO) said no major incidents were recorded during the festival, with police personnel deployed across the event area to monitor the crowd, manage security concerns, and assist in maintaining the flow of activities.
